merchant.name: bchain.ly
merchant.description: Bilingual storefront selling original digital artworks, paid directly with crypto.

steps: Open the browser URL and choose a product.
Select a network and scan the payment QR code with a wallet app, or copy the exact wallet address and amount.
Send the exact amount on the selected network.
Enter buyer email and the 64-character transaction hash in the payment window.
Send the prepared email to hello@bchain.ly.
Seller verifies the transaction on-chain and emails the full-resolution, unwatermarked file.

paymentQr.btc: BIP-21 bitcoin: URI including the exact amount
paymentQr.eth: ERC-681 ethereum: URI with value in wei
paymentQr.usdt-erc20: ERC-681 token transfer URI (USDT contract + recipient + amount)
paymentQr.usdt-trc20: plain Tron address; enter the amount manually

checkout.note: No automated payment API or card processing. An agent can prepare the order and open the mail app, but a human must send the crypto and the email.

mediaPolicy.fullResolution: delivered by email after payment verification
